svg.title: KB-0900: An RCD needs overcurrent protection
svg.desc: Two rails drawn to scale, each with an incoming single-pole breaker, a 40 A two-pole RCD and single-pole breakers. In (a) the incoming breaker is 40 A, no higher than the RCD, so its contacts are protected. In (b) the incoming breaker is 50 A and the breakers below add up to 16 + 16 + 16 = 48 A, both above 40 A, so the RCD is not protected.
